_note: «Для всех» (FR-ALL-001…005, docs/14 §16, D-90): universal(t) = Σ wᵢ·sᵢ / Σ wᵢ over the parts a track has — popularity (unique listeners, ListenBrainz, only with an MBID), sound, genre, guests (the separate model). Sound: closeness to the «universal sound» — valence and danceability at least the library's middle, energy near the middle, vocals present, tempo 90–130, 2.5–5 min, no extreme dynamics. Genre: tag words first (normalised, first hit), else the six groups of the vector. Exclusions are hard (never relaxed): the wave's own moods and characters (`assets/vibe`), «не для компании», explicit; tracks without deep analysis only as «Хит для всех». Temporary values until calibration (OWN-08).
